never-have-i-ever.name: 🙅 Never have I ever
rules: The Host picks categories and reads each "Never have I ever…" statement aloud.
Players who have done it raise a finger (or take a sip — agree on house rules).
Brief story comments are fine, then the Host moves to the next question.
No judging — it's about fun and getting to know each other.

truth-or-dare.name: 🎭 Truth or dare
truth-or-dare.description: Answer honestly or complete a challenge.
rules: The Host picks categories and starts the game. The app picks a player for their turn.
The chosen player picks Truth or Dare and completes the task.
The Host runs the table — after the task, move to the next player.
The Host can enable safe mode (double-click the "Player turn" header) for milder cards.

impostor.name: 🕵️ Impostor
impostor.description: Find the impostor among the players.
rules: The Host draws a word and Impostors. Everyone checks their role on their phone.
Players know the word — not the category. The Impostor only sees the word's category.
A starting player is drawn for associations; turn order follows how you sit.
After discussion, vote for the Impostor. If caught, they lose the round.

mafia.name: 🌃 Mafia
mafia.description: The city sleeps, mafia wakes. Game master required.
rules: The Game Master (Host) picks roles so the total equals players at the table.
After dealing, everyone checks their secret role on their phone. Mafia knows their allies.
Run night and day phases verbally — the app helps the GM mark alive and dead players.
The town wins when mafia is eliminated. Mafia wins when they take over the town.

dark-stories.name: 🕯️ Dark stories
dark-stories.description: Yes/No riddles — narrator knows the dark solution.
rules: The Host is the narrator — they know each story's full solution (only on their screen).
The narrator reads the riddle aloud (scenario without explanation). Others uncover it with questions.
Players ask questions the narrator answers only with: Yes, No, or Irrelevant.
When someone thinks they solved it, they explain their theory. The narrator confirms if they're close or correct.
After solving, the narrator may reveal the solution for everyone, then move to the next story (reveal resets).

who-would-rather.name: 🤔 Would you rather
who-would-rather.description: Random player picks between options A and B.
rules: The Host picks categories and starts the game. The app picks a player and shows a dilemma.
The chosen player says whether they pick A or B — others listen and comment.
After the answer, the Host moves to the next player and dilemma.
No judging — it's about fun and getting to know the group.

kto-najpredzej.name: 👆 Who's most likely
kto-najpredzej.description: Point at who best fits the question.
rules: The Host picks categories and reads the on-screen question aloud.
Everyone at once points at who fits best (out loud, not in the app).
The person with the most fingers may briefly explain — then the next question.
No blame — it's fun, not a verdict.

one-night-werewolf.name: 🐺 One Night Werewolf
one-night-werewolf.description: One night — werewolves, villagers and special roles.

decrypto.name: 🔐 Decrypto
decrypto.description: Two teams — encrypt clues, opponents try to break them.

fake-artist.name: 🎨 Fake Artist
fake-artist.description: Everyone draws — one doesn't know the card.

just-one.name: 💡 Just One
just-one.description: The listener guesses the word — duplicate clues are removed.
rules: The Host picks categories and starts. One player is the listener (does not see the word) — everyone else hold the screen to peek at the word, like in Impostor.
Everyone else submits one-word clues — no talking and no peeking at others' entries.
When all clues are in, they are revealed. If the same word appears more than once (this round or any earlier round), none of those clues are shown to the listener.
The word is drawn once for the whole game. The listener only sees unique clues from the current round. After a missed guess, a new listener — same word, new clues.

sing-it.name: 🎤 Sing it
sing-it.description: Sing a song with the word — first to grab the mic wins.
rules: The Host picks word categories (random EN/PL or artist packs) and how the word is displayed.
All in: every phone shows the word. Selected phones: only chosen devices show it — in all orientations so you can place one in the center of the table.
After the word is revealed, the first person to pick up the physical microphone and sing a song containing that word wins the round.
The Host moves to the next word after the round is settled. It's about reflex and song knowledge — no vocal judging in the app.

top-ten.name: 🔟 Top Ten
top-ten.description: Act out the word on your 1–10 scale — then line up in order.
rules: The Host draws one shared word and unique numbers 1–10 for each player (hold the screen to peek).
Everyone acts out how they'd do the activity at their level — without saying the number.
A random player arranges everyone from weakest (1) to strongest (10) based only on the performances.
The Host reveals the real numbers — compare with the guesser's order and draw the next word.

miners.name: ⛏️ Miners
miners.description: Mine gold — watch for cave-ins and betrayal.

say-anything.name: 💬 Say Anything
say-anything.description: Bet on what the chosen player will answer.

telepathy.name: 🧠 Telepathy
telepathy.description: Everyone types the same word — no talking. Words are revealed at the end of the round.
rules: The Host starts the game. Each round, every player enters one word — no peeking and no discussion.
Words are revealed after the round. The Host can enable auto next round or confirm each round manually.
Words used in earlier rounds cannot be used again — check the blocked list (comparison ignores case, spaces, punctuation, and accents: ą/a, ę/e, etc.).
Goal: everyone enters the same word — then the game ends. On a shared phone, also enter for guests at the table.

bleff.name: 🃏 Bleff
bleff.description: Bluff definitions — vote for what sounds most believable.

dutch.name: 🎴 Dutch
dutch.description: Fast card game — shed cards at the right moment.

jungle-speed.name: 🌴 Jungle Speed
jungle-speed.description: WORK IN PROGRESS — reflex, symbols, totem, shape matching.
rules: Each player has a hidden deck and a face-up pile. On their turn, they reveal one card onto their pile.
Duels are matched only by shape. Color never changes the result.
The TOTEM button always pauses the game (STOP), the system provides a suggestion, and the host makes the final call.
The host can approve the suggestion, override the winner, or apply a penalty. After the decision, all face-up cards are moved to the selected player and the table is cleared.
A player wins when, after resolution, they have both 0 hidden cards and 0 face-up cards.
